name: Weather
description: Just the weather, over the day’s selected artwork: today first, with the temperature now, the hours ahead, sunrise and sunset, then the next seven days. This Astro layout owns its Open-Meteo integration.

settings.label: Weather location
settings.description: City and state or country, for example Boston, MA.

display_settings.label: Show the artwork behind the weather
display_settings.description: Turn this off to show the weather on a plain dark background on this TV.
